summary: Frontend regression for MEN-03 (CourierPanel) + Historial Separado + Auditoría de Asignación + MEN-01/MEN-02 visual regression. All 8 verification points PASS. Tested with session_token=men03_vip (VIP mensajero) and session_token=men03_admin (admin) on desktop 1920x1080.

test_results.MEN-03_courier_assigned_section: PASS - [data-testid=courier-assigned-to-me] present; reserved card [data-testid=delivery-card-men03smoke_res] visible alongside [data-testid=courier-free-jobs-title].
test_results.MEN-03_text_buttons: PASS - 'Aceptar entrega' ([data-testid=claim-delivery-men03smoke_res]) and 'Rechazar entrega' ([data-testid=reject-reservation-men03smoke_res]) are visible text buttons on the reserved card.
test_results.MEN-03_filter_isolation: PASS - Applying 'Retiro en efectivo' kind filter on Trabajos libres hid the free (Recogida/deposit) card but KEPT the reserved card visible. Applying 'Matanzas' zone filter kept both visible (reserved is La Habana → in Asignadas a mí section which is NOT filtered; free is Matanzas).
test_results.MEN-03_deep_link_highlight: PASS - /dashboard/deliveries?delivery=men03smoke_res opens with the card classes containing 'ring-2 ring-[#EAB308] shadow-[0_0_24px_rgba(234,179,8,0.25)]' (yellow ring). Opening the deep link did NOT auto-accept the delivery.
test_results.MEN-03_deep_link_gone_toast: PASS - /dashboard/deliveries?delivery=nonexistent_xxx shows Sonner toast 'Esta entrega ya no está disponible o ya fue gestionada.' (courierPanel.deepLinkGone i18n).
test_results.MEN-03_notification_bell: PASS - Clicking a 'Nueva entrega asignada' notification item ([data-testid=notification-item-<id>]) navigates to /dashboard/deliveries?delivery=<delivery_id>. When the referenced delivery no longer exists, the deepLinkGone toast is shown (expected). Both read and unread items navigate.
test_results.Historial_Separado: PASS - [data-testid=admin-tab-deliveries] and [data-testid=admin-tab-history] both present. Entregas tab shows 'Reservada Smoke' (reserved/active) and does NOT show 'Confirmada Smoke' / 'Cancelada Smoke'. Historial tab shows the confirmed and cancelled entries with filter chips 'Todas / Confirmada / Cancelada', and does NOT include the reserved entry.
test_results.Auditoria_asignacion: PASS - Clicking a reserved delivery row opens [data-testid=delivery-details-dialog]; the fila [data-testid=dd-assigned-by] shows 'ASIGNADA POR Admin Test · 10/12/2026, 4:06:55 PM'.
test_results.MEN-02_visual_regression: PASS - Reserved delivery row shows 'ASIGNADA — PENDIENTE DE ACEPTACIÓN' badge with sub-line 'Reservada para VIP Test' ([data-testid=admin-assigned-to-men03smoke_res]); filter [data-testid=deliveries-filter-assigned] present.
test_results.MEN-01_visual_regression: PASS - Admin sees [data-testid=assign-courier-men03smoke_free] selector on the free delivery row.

test_credentials: Cookie session_token=men03_vip (user_test_vip01, courier), session_token=men03_admin (user_test_admin01, admin). Both work via withCredentials.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; used pre-seeded men03smoke_res / men03smoke_free / men03smoke_done / men03smoke_cxl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MEN-03 frontend fully green. CourierPanel section 'Asignadas a mí' is isolated from kind/zone filters as designed. Deep-link highlight + gone-toast work. NotificationBell navigates for both delivery_assigned (new behavior) and already-read items. Admin Historial tab is correctly segregated from Entregas. dd-assigned-by audit row renders name + localized date.
